_doc: Briefs for the 15 champions added in the pattern-skirmish prototype (2026-11-19). Same style text as skirmish_sprites.json; the raw image of 'anchor' in production/art_review/skirmish/ is the style reference. Run: python tools/asset_gen/gen_sprites.py --spec pattern_sprites.json --out game/art
styleCharacter: Cute cartoon mobile-game character sprite in a chibi style: oversized head about a third of the total height, short stubby body and limbs, big expressive eyes, thick dark brown outlines, flat cel shading with one shadow tone and one soft highlight, bright saturated colours, a bold readable silhouette with one clear main colour. Seen in three-quarter front view from slightly above, as if on an isometric game board, standing in a confident idle pose holding its weapon, full body with feet visible, centred, filling about 80% of the image height. One character only. No ground, no cast shadow, no text, no frame, no border, no scenery.
styleStructure: Cute cartoon mobile-game building sprite: chunky toy-like proportions, thick dark brown outlines, flat cel shading with one shadow tone and one soft highlight, bright saturated colours. Seen in three-quarter view from above, as if standing on an isometric game board, centred, filling about 80% of the image height. One object only. No ground, no cast shadow, no text, no frame, no border, no scenery.
background: The background is one perfectly flat, uniform solid {bgName} colour ({bgHex}) filling the whole image edge to edge, with no gradient, no vignette and no texture. Do not use {bgName} anywhere on the subject.
referenceNote: Match the art style of the reference image exactly: the same outline thickness, the same shading, the same chibi proportions, the same camera angle and the same level of detail. Draw a completely different character, described here:

assets.subject: Cinder, a burly lava golem brawler: a cracked black rock body with glowing orange magma seams, huge molten fists, small ember eyes, a little flame on top of the head; black, orange and red.

Gale, a nimble wind monk warrior: flowing white and sky-blue robes that billow, a long staff with a spinning pinwheel on top, swirling wind ribbons around the arms, a calm confident smile, hair in a topknot.
Thorn, a hulking tree-stump guardian: a body of dark bark covered in thorny brambles and red berries, a heavy wooden club, glowing amber eyes peering from a hollow; dark brown, deep green and red.
Fang, a stocky wolf-beast hunter: grey-brown fur, big fangs and a toothy grin, a leather harness with stone amulets, large stone-tipped claws, a bushy tail; brown, grey and moss green.

Wisp, a small glowing light spirit rogue: a hooded cloak of pale gold, a round luminous face with big bright eyes, a tiny lantern on a hooked stick, sparkles trailing behind; pale yellow, white and gold.
Shiver, a frost lynx prowler standing upright: white and pale blue fur with icy tufts on the ears, long ice-crystal claws, a short blue scarf, narrow glowing blue eyes; white, ice blue and silver.
Pyra, a young fire sorceress: a tall pointed hat with a burning tip, red and orange robes, a ball of fire floating above one open hand, a staff with a glowing coal, a cheeky smile.
Umbra, a shadow warlock: a long dark purple hooded robe with a starry lining, a face hidden in shadow with two glowing violet eyes, a floating dark orb between the hands, wisps of purple smoke.

Quartz, a crystal mage: a body partly made of faceted rose and white crystal, a robe of sandy cloth, a large glowing crystal shard floating over one palm, a gentle face with a crystal crown; pink, white and sand.

Flint, a sharpshooter with a long flintlock rifle: a wide-brimmed hat with a feather, a long brown coat with brass buttons, small sparks of yellow lightning on the rifle barrel, goggles on the forehead, a smirk; brown, brass and electric yellow.
Hail, a frost archer: a fur-lined pale blue parka with the hood up, a bow made of clear ice with an icicle arrow, rosy cheeks, a few snowflakes around; pale blue, white and silver.
Dusk, a shadow crossbow hunter: a dark teal and black cloak with a raven-feather collar, a compact crossbow, a half mask, a small raven perched on the shoulder, glowing amber eyes.
Brook, a water healer: flowing hair made of water, a robe of teal and seafoam with shell ornaments, a bubble of water floating above a coral staff, a kind smile; teal, aqua and white.
Ash, a fire dancer priestess: a red and gold dancer outfit with flowing ribbons, two flaming fans, a phoenix feather headdress, a warm confident smile; red, gold and orange.

Moss, a small plump forest druid turtle standing upright: a mossy shell with mushrooms and a little sapling growing on it, a wooden staff wrapped in vines, a sleepy friendly face; olive green, brown and cream.
